fresco: modular retained-mode UI engine for Rust

fresco: WyattAu estate UI engine. Crates: path-kit (L0 geometry),
anim-kit (L0 closed-form springs), scene-kit (L1 retained scene, damage
tracking), layout-kit (L1 incremental layout, no_std), paint-kit (L2 CPU
raster, exact coverage), render-conformance (L3 golden images,
unpublished).

Spec: SPEC.md (REQ-P*, REQ-A*, REQ-S*, REQ-L*, REQ-R*, REQ-C*).
Contract: AGENTS.md. Decisions: docs/adr/ADR-0001..0004.
Paradigm index (651 to 1050): docs/paradigms.md.
Layering: L0 std zero-dep (layout-kit additionally no_std+alloc);
L1 std, internal deps only; L2 std; L3 dev-only.
Commands: cargo test --workspace --all-features; cargo clippy --workspace
--all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --all -- --check.
Rules: forbid(unsafe_code) everywhere; lints deny panic/unwrap/expect;
indexing_slicing denied in src, allowed in test modules; MSRV 1.92;
edition 2024.
